title: MPS calculator: approve the rental full proposal's new words, with three wording fixes, before it goes on the hosted site
bluf:
Kam: tap a to approve the rental full proposal's new words, including three wording fixes the check found. Friday then has the three sentences changed and re-checked, puts the book on the hosted site, and tells you.

The rental full proposal is built and passed its quality check. Before it goes on the hosted site, its new wording needs your yes.

The 38 new phrases, by section. Cover: the rental line under the title and the monthly charge tile. Section 1: the price table headings, the total and contract value rows, the default summary and a pricing note. Section 2: sites by stream, and 'Site not stated'. Sections 3 to 5: titles, sub-headings, four 'what the monthly charge includes' bullets, the supply rows, the sum of the four parts, the per-line formula, and page rates by line. Sections 6, 8 and 10: the hardware support row, the analytics note, and the summary labels. All 38 print word for word, and nothing else is new. The full numbered list is in the pack.

One sentence retires: 'For purchase quotes only: a rental quote has no proposal template yet.' Rental quotes now have a proposal.

Fix 1. The sentence 'The total monthly charge is the sum of the line monthly charges in the schedule above.' is wrong by a cent on 23 of 60 real quotes, because each line is rounded on its own. Proposed: 'The total monthly charge is worked out for the whole fleet. Each line's monthly charge is rounded to the cent, so the line charges above may not add up exactly to the total.'

Fix 2. Older rental quotes, approved before prices were broken down, show no parts, but the pricing note still says 'the sum of the four components above'. For those quotes only, proposed: 'The monthly charge covers the fleet, options and software in this proposal. This quote was approved before charges were itemised, so no breakdown is shown.' The rest of the note stays.

Fix 3. The pricing note's last sentence, 'The contract value is the total of the monthly charges over the {term}-month term.', is also only true before rounding: on one test quote $4,153.37 × 60 = $249,202.20, but the book prints $249,201.99. Proposed: 'The contract value is worked out for the whole {term}-month term, so it can differ by a few cents from the monthly charge multiplied by the term.'

All three fixes are Friday's proposed wording. Change them under b.
default_action: Nothing goes on the hosted site; the book stays merged but unseen.

options.label: Approve all, with the three fixes as proposed
options.detail: All 38 phrases and the retired sentence are approved as listed, with Fixes 1, 2 and 3 worded as proposed. Friday has a seat change the three sentences and gets them re-checked, then deploys to the hosted site and tells you.

options.label: Approve with changes
options.detail: Write the changes in a note. Name rows by number from the pack (1 to 38), or say Fix 1, 2 or 3. Changed words go through a seat and a check before the hosted site changes.

options.label: Hold
options.detail: The book stays merged on main and does not go on the hosted site. Friday asks you what to change.
